    1 * trade_when(
        rank(ts_std_dev(returns, 20)) > 0.7,
        group_backfill(winsorize(-inverse(cash)), industry, 20),
        rank(ts_std_dev(returns, 20)) < 0.4
    )

        -group_backfill(group_zscore(is_nan(assets), subindustry), market, 30),
        industry
    )
)
